body:
Completed with published evidence at `7f293a22d97317d1632952a5cf2e9d4a45bd2cb2` and qualified candidate `ee014909137e03706e0b3020b8396be589aaa705`. Four real partial copies are killed after 258,048 of 8,391,392 bytes. Actual UI retry restores all originals; the next backup preserves the displaced save in the current shelf. Fresh-root07 separately proves settings/content backups and automatic save receive/send with exact witnesses.

[Final audit record](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/7f293a22d97317d1632952a5cf2e9d4a45bd2cb2/docs/audits/2026_10_06-milestone-m7-p4-fixes-383/08-installed-resolution.md). Device testing and release publication retain their separate gates.
